# Third-party code

asciinema-player.min.js and asciinema-player.css are asciinema-player 3.17.0 (https://github.com/asciinema/asciinema-player), unmodified, under the Apache License 2.0 in LICENSE. Its bundle includes solid-js, solid-transition-group and @babel/runtime, and its WebAssembly the Rust crates talc, serde-wasm-bindgen and rgb, all under the MIT License; their notices follow. The other crates in its WebAssembly are dual-licensed under MIT or Apache 2.0 and are covered by LICENSE.
